objects.description: [InvisibleFerret](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1245) has leveraged Telegram chat to upload stolen data using the Telegram API with a bot token.(Citation: ESET Contagious Interview BeaverTail InvisibleFerret February 2025)(Citation: Zscaler ContagiousInterview BeaverTail InvisibleFerret November 2024)
objects.description_fa: [InvisibleFerret](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1245) از چت تلگرام برای آپلود داده‌های دزدیده شده با استفاده از API تلگرام با رمز ربات استفاده کرده است.(Citation: ESET Contagious Interview BeaverTail InvisibleFerret February 2025)[[[CTI_PRESERVE_1]] (Citation: Zscaler ContagiousInterview BeaverTail InvisibleFerret November 2024)
